headline: Arcade steady; factory asks what to build next
lede: No new game this slot — the queue ran dry mid-shift. Emberwood got its QA polish on main and slot-b keeps grinding the seedpin rollout, while the studio files its first-ever 'what's next' question for Jon.

notes.text: Slot a closed a full dry-board audit: no steer/next/game-queue items, QA still inside Weight Surgery (#1520, PR #1528), and every flagship README gap — SSX, Emberwood, Comet Drift HD, Myst — is now CLOSED by shipped work. Stop derived honestly via idle.mjs, not from memory.
#1530 filed: which title joins the arcade next? Contra-style run-and-gun or Puzzle Bobble both fit the collection's classic coverage; lanes hold and re-ladder until Jon picks.
Seedpin rollout (#1473) stays with slot-b — live checkpoints, b17 pushed. Pong and Asteroids already replay pinned by seed; the classic-port batches follow.
